fact.title: Test cases of xslt40-test in the XSLT 4.0 gate scope
fact.expression: let $sets := doc("third_party/xslt40-test/catalog.xml")/*:catalog/*:test-set let $cases := $sets ! doc(resolve-uri(@file, base-uri(.)))//*:test-case let $spec := fn($case) { ($case/*:dependencies/*:spec, $case/../*:dependencies/*:spec)[1] } let $xslt40 := $cases[let $s := $spec(.) return empty($s) or (some $token in tokenize($s/@value) satisfies $token = ("XSLT10+", "XSLT20+", "XSLT30+", "XSLT40+", "XSLT40"))] let $excluded := ("schema_aware", "streaming", "dtd", "XML_1.1", "XSD_1.1", "backwards_compatibility", "HTML4", "ICU_spellout") return count($xslt40[not(tokenize(base-uri(.), "/")[last() - 2] = ("strm", "sandp"))] [not((*:dependencies/*:feature, ../*:dependencies/*:feature)[not(@satisfied = "false")][tokenize(@value) = $excluded])])
